fields.title: Bitcoin falls below $50,000 by May 18, 2027
fields.text: Bitcoin trades below $50,000 at any time from November 19, 2026 through May 18, 2027. It stood near $63,000 on November 19, about 27% below its October 4 close of $86,475.
fields.resolution_source: Bitcoin spot price on major exchanges (Binance BTC/USDT, Coinbase)
